newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnlines to up stake in BTL to 32 pct. [CORRECTED 13:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Finnlines to up stake in BTL to 32 pct. [CORRECTED 13:42 GMT]

text.p: Finnish shipping firm Finnlines Oy said on Wednesday it would exercise its options to up its stake in Swedish transport firm Bilspedition Transport & Logistics (BTL) to 32 percent from 26 percent.

It said in a statement it would purchase 7,539,378 BTL A shares and 20,000 BTL B shares from Walleniusrederierna AB for 25 crowns per share and 4,121,850 BTL A shares from AB Catena, also for 25 crowns each.

"Finnlines' ownership in BTL is long-term and strategically significant," Finnlines said, adding the deal not would influence its subsidiaries or their operations. (Corrects that the deal would not have an influence)
After the transactions, Finnlines would hold 24,177,309 A shares and 11,323,728 B shares, representing 31.58 percent of shares and 45.76 percent of votes in BTL, it said.
